# The down plan over the prefill classes (generated by `host/sim/lin/gen.ts checks host/sim/lin/plan.json`)

`plan("rowMajor", M)` (kernels/trellis/down-mma-wide.ts:46) at `M` the step's rows, in each row of a class
whose forward runs the wide down projection (`VW`: tails of 9…223 rows, whole chunks of 64 and 128): the
band's oracle (`host.sim.lin.G10.planD`, a model of the stage's comparisons until its template exists)
checked by `goodEnum` at every value of `M` the row allows.
